_comment: Allowlist for scripts/scan-security.mjs. Add an entry per knowingly-accepted high/critical npm-audit advisory that has no fix available, so the security gate can stay green without ignoring NEW issues. Each entry: { "id": <advisory id or GHSA string>, "reason": "why it is accepted", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. Keep this list empty unless an advisory is reviewed and consciously accepted; review on expiry. The "id" is matched against the advisory's numeric `id`, its `github_advisory_id` (GHSA-...), and its CVE(s).
